record.question: A penalty of withholding promotion was imposed on a Group B officer. What condition must apply for this to be treated as a major penalty?
options: It is linked to a time-bound promotion scheme
It is imposed for more than one year
It is imposed with cumulative effect
It is followed by a criminal suit against him/her
record.explanation: Withholding promotion is major penalty if imposed with cumulative effect.
